assumptions:
1. Node names and Types are chosen according to users description.
2. Assumed the ID "src" for the Source and "sink" for the Sink as they were not explicitly named in the description.
3. Used a single buffer wherever the number of buffers between nodes was not specified.
4. Since only 5 buffers (B0 to B4) are specified for the 6 required connections in the sequence (Source -> M1 -> M2 -> M3 -> M4 -> M5 -> Sink), assumed an additional default buffer with default capacity is used to connect M5 to the Sink.
5. Assumed logical flow of parts is strictly sequential from the Source, through machines M1 to M5, and finally to the Sink.
6. Used default values for all missing parameters for all components.
